from.n: accepts a string content-addressed document whose string hashes to its id

to.n: accepts a content-addressed document whose content hashes to its id

from.n: rejects a string content-addressed document whose string does not hash to its id

to.n: rejects a content-addressed document whose content hashes to neither its id nor its schema id

from.n: rejects deleting or patching a content-addressed document

to.n: admits no operation but `set` against a content-addressed document
